implemented_capabilities.capability: JS/TS code graph ingestion (functions, classes, imports, calls) via tree-sitter
implemented_capabilities.notes: Real AST parsing for JS/TS only. Resolves same-file, named/default/namespace imports and this/class method calls into CALLS edges; unresolved (stdlib, npm, dynamic) calls are deliberately dropped.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Downstream blast radius over CALLS edges with impact ranking
implemented_capabilities.notes: BFS in TypeScript via store.neighbors (depth cap 5, visited set, Function nodes only). impact_rank score = blastSize * severityWeight * (1 + avg CALLS degree of affected functions). The equivalent Cypher string (MATCH p=(src)-[:CALLS*1..N]->(affected:Function)) is returned for display but the analysis itself does not run in FalkorDB.
8 line-based regex rules (acknowledged conservative heuristics, no data flow). analyzeGraph turns hits into Finding nodes with FLAGGED_IN and REACHES edges.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Finding status carry-over and episodic Note/Session memory across scans
implemented_capabilities.notes: Statuses are carried by key ruleId+file+line from the previous JSON snapshot; mark_fixed writes status/fixedAt/fixCommit and a Note linked from the latest Session via REMEMBERS; recall is token-overlap keyword search. Weakness: a carried 'fixed' status is applied even if the rule still fires on that line (analyze.ts:134-135), and a line shift creates a new finding with no link to the old one.
Top committer on the owning file from git log history via execFile (no shell).

implemented_capabilities.capability: FalkorDB Cypher write path and guarded read-only cypher_query
implemented_capabilities.notes: Generates parameterised MERGE statements and executes them when FALKORDB_URL is reachable; one graph per repo. The README and cypher.ts header state live FalkorDB execution was UNVERIFIED by the author. Default store is the in-memory InMemoryGraphStore and analysis reads from a JSON snapshot hydrated into memory, so FalkorDB is effectively a write-through mirror.
/api/ask is keyword matching of a question to a function/file name, not an LLM; LLM_API_KEY env vars exist but no LLM code path was found.

graph_models_and_cypher: Labels: File, Function, Class, Import, Commit, Author, Finding, Session, Note. Edges: DEFINES, CALLS, IMPORTS, AUTHORED, TOUCHED, OWNS, FLAGGED_IN, REACHES, REMEMBERS. Writes: MERGE (n:`Label` {id: $id}) SET n += $props and MATCH (a {id:$from}),(b {id:$to}) MERGE (a)-[r:`TYPE`]->(b). Read: MATCH (n {id:$id}) RETURN n; blast radius Cypher MATCH p=(src)-[:CALLS*1..N]->(affected:Function) is generated for display. Labels/types interpolated from fixed TS enums, values parameterised. No APOC/GDS; graph-per-repo naming 'blastradius_<slug>'.
algorithms: BFS downstream over CALLS with depth cap 5 and visited set (server/src/agent/tools.ts:reachableFunctions)
Impact score = blast size * severity weight * (1 + mean CALLS degree) (tools.ts:impact_rank)
Smallest-enclosing-function attribution of a finding line (detect/analyze.ts:flagTargetId)
Cross-file call resolution via import/export maps (ingest/resolve.ts)
Fail-closed read-only Cypher guard: leading-keyword allowlist plus write-keyword scan after stripping string literals (tools.ts:assertReadOnlyCypher)
backend_interfaces: Express routes: GET /health, GET /api/stats, GET /api/findings, GET /api/blast-radius/:findingId, POST /api/scan, GET /api/ask
frontend_interfaces: React/Vite client: client/src/App.tsx, client/src/components/GraphView.tsx, client/src/api.ts (VITE_API_URL, default http://localhost:4000)
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Deterministic orchestrator (agent/loop.ts:runScan: scan -> detect -> rank -> report); no LLM tool-calling loop is implemented despite the 'agent' naming. Memory = Session and Note nodes with REMEMBERS edges plus carried finding statuses, persisted as JSON snapshots (graph/snapshot.ts) rather than read back from FalkorDB.
tests_present: 8 Vitest files under server/test (~90 it/test cases: api, detect, loop, parser, scan, seed, store, tools) using in-memory store and fixture repos; Cypher statement generation is unit-tested without a live DB. Nothing exercises live FalkorDB.
security_findings: server/src/ingest/scanner.ts:111-114 - execFile('git',['clone','--depth','1',target,tmp]) with no '--' separator; app.ts:261-266 accepts any string ending in '.git' even if it begins with '-', so a crafted value like '--upload-pack=...<x>.git' is git option injection (potential command execution)
server/src/app.ts:257-282 - POST /api/scan, unauthenticated, clones arbitrary remote URLs (SSRF/outbound git) or scans any local path on the server (path read), then writes snapshots
server/src/app.ts:122 - cors() with default allow-all origin and no auth on any route

server/src/graph/cypher.ts:279-296 - temporarily installs a process-level 'uncaughtException' handler and a custom RESP socket probe (probeEndpoint) to connect to a user-supplied FALKORDB_URL; connects to arbitrary host:port from env (outbound TCP)
server/src/agent/tools.ts:139-165 - cypher_query read-only guard is regex-based (documented limitation); only reachable when a live Cypher store is configured
server/src/detect/rules.ts:77-123 - rule file itself includes secret regex patterns (detector, not a leak); excerpts are masked via maskSecret
No eval/exec/pickle in the product code; child_process use is execFile (no shell) in scanner.ts:79,114 and git.ts:46. No hard-coded secrets (FALKORDB_URL and LLM_* from env).
duplicates_or_overlaps: Direct overlap with blast-radius traversal (code call-graph reachability), software dependency intelligence, static-security findings, and agent memory of resolved findings. Same title 'blastradius' appears in several other batch repos (986036734, NishaadG, Rakesh9742, kushalkumarcs372, sevenhiremath, AgentAhmed).
evidence_drift_relevance: LOW - carries finding status across scans and records Note/Session memory, but statuses are keyed on file+line, there is no supersession, temporal validity or invalidation (and a stale 'fixed' flag can mask a still-firing rule).

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Small, clean, tested BFS blast-radius with depth cap plus a severity-times-reach-times-centrality ranking formula and a reusable read-only Cypher guard; trivially portable to Python (about 60 lines of logic). The tree-sitter ingest (parser.ts, resolve.ts) is the larger real asset but is JS/TS-specific.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: Node >=20 (TypeScript); FalkorDB optional; no LLM key

strategy_rationale: The code is real and tested but is a TypeScript/Node project, so it cannot be merged into the Python/FastAPI Kairos tree; run as a sidecar code-graph scanner or re-implement reachableFunctions/impact_rank in Python. Fix the git option-injection and add auth before exposing /api/scan.
